artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflections on the metal tools are slightly smeared and lack the crisp, high-contrast specular highlights expected of polished steel, giving them a slightly 'waxy' or AI-generated appearance.

Several of the hinged instruments have poorly defined pivot points. The screws/rivets that hold the two halves together are either missing, fused, or indistinct, which is a common AI failure mode for complex mechanical objects.
Some of the finer tips appear to melt into the background pocket or curve unnaturally, lacking the precise straightness or taper of real surgical steel.
